response: The Research and Development Cell (R&D Cell) is responsible for promoting research activities, innovation, academic research, and development initiatives within the institution. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Research-and-Development-Cell-RD-CELL-2026-27.pdf

The Grievance Redressal Committee provides a mechanism for addressing and resolving grievances related to students and institutional matters. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Grievance-Redressal-Committee-GRC.pdf

The Academic Committees support academic planning, coordination, monitoring, and other academic activities of the institution. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Academic-Committees-2026-27.pdf

The Student Grievance Redressal Cell provides students with a formal mechanism to submit and resolve grievances related to their academic and institutional concerns. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Student-Grievance-Redressal-Cell-SGRC-2026-27.pdf

The SC-ST Committee works to address matters concerning students belonging to SC and ST categories and supports an inclusive and supportive academic environment. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SC-ST-COMMITTEE-2026-27.pdf

The Internal Complaint Committee deals with complaints and matters covered under its institutional responsibilities and works toward maintaining a safe and respectful environment within the college. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Internal-Complaint-Committee-2026-27.pdf

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) works toward maintaining and improving the quality of academic and institutional processes and supports continuous quality enhancement. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Internal-Quality-Assurance-Cell-IQAC-2026-27.pdf

The Institution-Industry Cell promotes interaction and collaboration between the institution and industry to support practical learning, industry exposure, and professional development of students. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/INSTITUTION-INDUSTRY-CELL-2026-27.pdf

The Tobacco Control Committee works to promote a tobacco-free campus and create awareness among students and staff about the harmful effects of tobacco use. For committee details, visit https://mgmnoida.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Tobacco-Control-Committee-2026-27.pdf
